exposure: Women with a fetus in cephalic presentation at delivery
cohort: Women with a fetus in cephalic presentation at delivery
finding: Successful external cephalic version (ECV) was associated with differences in labor progress and obstetrical outcomes compared to spontaneous cephalic presentation, but no significant differences in immediate neonatal outcomes were observed.
mod_finding: This study found that women who underwent successful external cephalic version had a higher proportion of induced labor, use of oxytocin during labor, longer duration of labor, lower rate of spontaneous delivery, and higher rate of intrapartum cesarean section compared to women with spontaneous cephalic presentation.
